nodes.name: Settlement
nodes.notes: First structure. Resource drop-off, initial population-cap bonus, villager production, and required to advance.

nodes.name: Advance to Stone Age
nodes.notes: Resources are spent when research begins. First major civilization transition.

nodes.name: Barracks
nodes.notes: First dedicated military structure.

nodes.name: Simple Stone Tools
nodes.notes: Foundational Stone Age tool technology.

nodes.name: Stone Axe
nodes.notes: Primitive axe technology.

nodes.name: Woodcutting
nodes.notes: Villagers can now harvest trees. Major timber construction waits for Copper Age.

nodes.name: Wood
nodes.notes: Useful modestly in Stone Age, much more important in Copper Age.

nodes.name: Hide Working
nodes.notes: Improves use of hunted animals and enables Leather recovery.

nodes.name: Leather
nodes.cost: Harvested from animals after Hide Working
nodes.notes: Prehistoric hunting yields Food only. Stone Age knowledge makes hides useful.

nodes.name: Leatherworking
nodes.notes: Turns raw hides into useful equipment and enables armour/sling technology.

nodes.name: Simple Leather Armour
nodes.notes: Modest armour improvement, visually represented on appropriate units.

nodes.name: Clubman
nodes.notes: Cheap primitive melee generalist.

nodes.name: Spearman
nodes.notes: Primitive sharpened wooden spear, with reach advantage.

nodes.name: Stone Thrower
nodes.notes: First dedicated ranged land unit. Once Slinger is unlocked, Stone Thrower is removed from new production; existing Stone Throwers may upgrade into Slingers or, later, directly into Simple Bowmen.

nodes.name: Stone Points
nodes.notes: Precision stoneworking. Feeds Pickaxes, Stone Cutting, stone-tipped weapons, and later arrowhead development.

nodes.name: Pickaxe
nodes.notes: Allows villagers to mine proper Stone Deposits instead of relying only on loose surface stone.

nodes.name: Stone Cutting
nodes.notes: Allows shaped stone and becomes a gateway to later masonry. Optional for Copper advancement.

nodes.name: Stone-tipped Spears
nodes.notes: Improves Spearmen with stone tips and better piercing damage.

nodes.name: Sling Making
nodes.notes: Cross-branch tech requiring Leatherworking; enables Slinger upgrade.

nodes.name: Slinger
nodes.notes: Improved Stone Age ranged unit unlocked by Sling Making. Existing Stone Throwers may upgrade into Slingers; once Slinger is available, Stone Thrower is removed from new production.

nodes.name: Improved Settlement Storage
nodes.notes: Small settlement storage upgrade; no separate Storage Camp until Copper Age.

nodes.name: Improved Settlement Shelter
nodes.notes: Small settlement housing/pop-cap improvement. Dedicated housing waits for Copper Age.

nodes.name: Advance to Copper Age
nodes.notes: Requires Settlement, Woodcutting, and Stone Points. Stone Cutting is optional.

nodes.name: Copper
nodes.notes: New strategic resource that changes how the map is evaluated.

nodes.name: Simple Dock
nodes.notes: Primitive coastal production building. Produces Fishing Raft, Transport Raft, and War Raft.

nodes.name: Fishing Raft
nodes.notes: Primitive fishing vessel.

nodes.name: Transport Raft
nodes.notes: Primitive unit transport across water.

nodes.name: War Raft
nodes.notes: Primitive combat raft and the ancestor of later purpose-built war vessels.

nodes.name: Workshop
nodes.notes: First immediate Copper Age building. Research hub for organized construction and practical upgrades.

nodes.name: Timber Construction
nodes.notes: Workshop research that unlocks organized timber-era infrastructure and naval modernization.

nodes.name: Timber Framing
nodes.notes: Allows timber-era buildings to be upgraded, improving stats and visibly changing their construction.

nodes.name: Dedicated Housing
nodes.notes: Dedicated population-support buildings begin in Copper Age.

nodes.name: Storage Camp
nodes.notes: Local resource drop-off building. Prototype can still use a global stockpile.

nodes.name: Primitive Agriculture
nodes.notes: Unlocks crop-based food production. Granary also requires Timber Construction.

nodes.name: Granary
nodes.notes: Requires Timber Construction and Primitive Agriculture. Farms are built around/associated with it.

nodes.name: Farm
nodes.notes: Simple crop farm associated with the Granary.

nodes.name: Simple Bow
nodes.notes: Researchable ranged-weapon technology. Opens the dedicated archery branch.

nodes.name: Archery Range
nodes.notes: Requires Simple Bow and Timber Construction. Dedicated ranged-unit production building.

nodes.name: Simple Bowman
nodes.notes: Dedicated Copper Age ranged infantry trained from the Archery Range. Existing Stone Throwers and Slingers can upgrade directly into Simple Bowmen; once Simple Bowman is available, both older ranged classes are removed from new production.

nodes.name: Fletching
nodes.notes: Research upgrade improving Simple Bowman performance. Requires Arrow Making.

nodes.name: Maceman
nodes.notes: Workshop research that upgrades the Clubman line with bronze mace equipment; Chinese visuals can remain culturally specific.

nodes.name: Animal Husbandry
nodes.notes: Unlocks simple livestock production. Does not directly unlock a Stable.

nodes.name: Livestock Pen
nodes.notes: Holds pigs, sheep, cattle, etc. Prototype keeps livestock simple and primarily food-focused.

nodes.name: Fishing Boat
nodes.notes: Copper-era timber replacement for Fishing Raft.

nodes.name: Transport
nodes.notes: Copper-era timber replacement for Transport Raft.

nodes.name: Light War Boat
nodes.notes: Fast, cheap and maneuverable, but fragile.

nodes.name: Galley
nodes.notes: Flexible middle-ground combat vessel.

nodes.name: Heavy War Boat
nodes.notes: Slower and expensive, but durable and powerful.

nodes.name: Arrow Making
nodes.notes: Organized arrow production. Requires an Archery Range and Stone Points; leads to Fletching.

undefined.name: Terrain / Formation Bonuses
undefined.notes: Possible lightweight combat modifiers; not part of the current slice.

undefined.name: Palisades
undefined.notes: Copper-era defensive construction; exact prerequisites not yet locked.

undefined.name: Gate
undefined.notes: Gate for early defensive systems; exact prerequisites not yet locked.

undefined.name: Improved Settlement
undefined.notes: Copper-era settlement transformation; exact position not yet locked.

undefined.name: Stone Foundations
undefined.notes: Possible descendant of Stone Cutting; exact placement not locked.

undefined.name: Masonry
undefined.notes: Future descendant of Stone Cutting; exact placement not locked.

undefined.name: Horse Domestication
undefined.notes: Later technology intended to precede Stable and mounted units.

undefined.name: Stable
undefined.notes: Reserved for after Horse Domestication; not directly unlocked by Animal Husbandry.

undefined.name: Terrain / Formation Bonuses
undefined.notes: Potential lightweight combat modifiers; not part of the current prototype slice.

undefined.name: Sack
undefined.notes: Planned Villager upgrade: increases carrying capacity. Intended progression: Sack then Wheelbarrow. Bonus, cost, research time, epoch, research location and formal prerequisites TBD; not implemented in Prototype01.

undefined.name: Wheelbarrow
undefined.notes: Planned Villager upgrade: further carrying-capacity increase plus movement-speed increase. Follows Sack conceptually; formal prerequisites remain TBD. Bonuses, cost, research time, epoch and research location TBD; not implemented in Prototype01.
